deadline_review.evidence: The monotonic start is established before installing a 120-second ITIMER_REAL; the timer is armed before approval, authorization, dependency verification, and reservation. It remains active through producer setup, project-store close, operation settlement, result persistence, and canonical-store close. Deadline expiry propagates without intentionally converting an unresolved reservation into a settled success; the exclusive started marker prevents blind replay.
deadline_review.measurement_scope: The result explicitly measures through project-store close and excludes final ledger/report bookkeeping; whole_system_cost_complete is false. It does not claim full system cost. The timer can interrupt finalization, in which case the durable ledger and one-shot marker must be read before any recovery; no automatic retry is allowed.

preparation_review.finding: The prepare path persists schema-validated definitions and an inert request before execution reservation. This matches existing extensions.prepare and boundary.prepare_model_probe request-preparation patterns and the policy distinction that a proposal/request is not approval or execution. It creates no project, invokes no producer setup, and starts no task, model, or worker.
preparation_review.preparation_resource_cost: unknown; no duration or resource measurement was available to this read-only review. Do not infer zero or change grant counters. Carry any required preparation-cost lineage forward according to the assessment policy.
